# QYL0303: Missing resource attributes

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Resource attributes 'service.name' and 'service.version' are required for proper service identification in observability backends. These attributes enable grouping traces by service and tracking version-specific behavior. Use ResourceBuilder.CreateDefault().AddService(serviceName, serviceVersion) to set them.
